events.name: ECB Interest Rate Decision
events.note: Expected quarter-point hike; press conference at 14:45 CET

deep_analysis.text: Equities are softer and volatility is climbing while gold edges higher and Bitcoin slips, a mixed backdrop that leans cautious rather than a clean risk-off sweep since the dollar index sits flat and yields tick only marginally higher. Gold's neutral signal alongside a stalled DXY suggests the safe-haven bid is tentative, not confirmed across the board, leaving risk-sensitive currencies vulnerable but without strong conviction either way. Headlines center on diverging central bank paths, firmer US jobs data reviving Fed hike bets against ECB tightening chatter. The next major risk is US CPI and PPI data within hours, alongside back-to-back ECB, BoE, BoC and RBNZ decisions that could reshape rate-differential dynamics quickly.
